verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਾਹੁਣਾ ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਵਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: par ghar jai paraahunaa aasaa vich niraas valaae|

en.bdb: The guest in the house of other person remains unconcerned among many expectations.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਵਲ ਜਿਉ ਸੂਰਜ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: paanee a(n)dhar kaval jiau sooraj dhiaan alipat rahaae|

en.bdb: Lotus too in the water concentrates upon sun and remains uninfluenced by water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਤਿਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਦੀ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat satisa(n)g mil gur chele dhee sa(n)dh milaae|

en.bdb: Likewise in the holy congregation the Guru and disciple meet through word (shabad) and meditative faculty (surati).

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚ ਖੰਡ ਵਸਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan gursikh hoi saadhasa(n)gat sach kha(n)dd vasaae|

en.bdb: People of the four varnas, by becoming followers of the Guru, reside in the abode of truth through the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ਚਬਾਇ ਸੁ ਰੰਗ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: aap gavai ta(n)bol ras khai chabai su ra(n)g chaRhaae|

en.bdb: Like the one coloured sap of betel-leaf they shed away their selfhood, and all are coloured in their one fast colour.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਤਰਸਨ ਖੜੇ ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥਿ ਗਿਰੰਥ ਸੁਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: chhia dharasan tarasan khaRe baareh pa(n)th gira(n)th sunaae|

en.bdb: All the six philosophies and the twelve sects of yogis covet by standing away (but do not get  that status because of their pride).

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤਿ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਦਿਖਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: chhia rut baareh maas kar ik ik sooraj cha(n)dh dhikhaae|

en.bdb: Six seasons, twelve months are shown to have one sun and one moon,

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹ ਸੋਲਹ ਮੇਲਿ ਕੈ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੂਰ ਸਮਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: baareh soleh mel kai saseear a(n)dhar soor samaae|

en.bdb: But the gurmukhs have fused the sun and the moon into each other, i.e. they have demolished the boundaries of the sattva and the rajas gunas.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਨੋ ਲੰਘਿ ਕੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਕੁ ਮਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: siv sakatee no la(n)gh kai gurmukh ik man ik dhiaae|

en.bdb: Having gone beyond the maya of Siva-sakti they medicate upon the one supreme.
Their humility makes the world fall at their feet.
